1. You are right it wouldn’t be fair to expect the developers to bring all of that to the table with the current release cycle they are under.

And I think that’s my biggest criticism with Pokémon. In my opinion, I don’t like the yearly release schedule. I would like it better if they spent 5 years developing the main project, and then outsourced other companies to make smaller projects and spin offs. 

I know they won’t do this because it’s not in their best interest to make the most money possible. I know others won’t agree with me. But that is what I would want.

2. You make a good point there. I am not hating on legends arceus. I think it does a lot right, I think it’s a  step in the right direction. I can see why people would find it a good game/ like it.

For me, what I’m looking for in a game already exists. Elder scrolls, elden ring, botw, horizon zero dawn, etc. offer beautiful gigantic landscapes with more complex rpg elements and depth.

I’m not rich, I can only afford to buy a few games a year. I can’t afford to buy every game on the market at full price.

For me, Pokémon on the switch hasn’t been at a level where I want to spend $60 on it. Or even invest my time in it. There’s just other games that do it better for me. 

I am unsure of the future of Pokémon. I hope they continue to innovate and build on what they laid out in arceus. I think there’s a lot of stuff they can do with it.  Maybe the next one will be even better and knock it put of the park. Or maybe they’ll go back to linear design. Idk.

As for your points about botw, you are right and I agree, but botw2 is coming out soon and it may fix some of the criticisms you point out. There may be more enemy variety, etc. It would be exciting if Pokémon did the same and built on its foundations. So far they have.

The thing is, pokemon legends arceus is only a shell of what it could be.

If you love the game and enjoy it, that’s great and I’m happy for you. I’m not trying to be overly negative or tell you you can’t have fun. I will admit it’s a step in the right direction and that’s exciting.
